title: Case: Age-restricted item needs delivery ID verification
context: A shipment of premium cutlery requires recipient age verification at point of delivery. The delivery attempt was made but the driver could not complete it due to missing identity documentation from the recipient. The desk must coordinate next steps.
initial_request: Coordinate resolution of a failed delivery requiring age verification.

events.from: Marcus Webb, Plover Arc Logistics Dispatch
events.body: Driver report: DL-951 delivery attempt failed at 14:15. Recipient refused to show ID. Signature required due to age-restricted goods policy. Driver left notice. Awaiting instructions.

events.from: Tanya Voss, Plover Arc Logistics Routing control
events.body: DL-951 flagged for reattempt. Recipient name on waybill is T. Moretti but driver noted 'possibly different person answered door'. No age verification possible without valid ID. Next slot available Thursday 2026-04-25 morning.

events.from: Tanya Voss, Plover Arc Logistics Routing control
events.body: Escalation: DL-951 cannot proceed without ID check resolved. Recipient identity unconfirmed. Please advise on reattempt or alternative.

acceptable_actions.summary: Request valid ID be ready for Thursday reattempt; confirm recipient name T. Moretti
Confirm recipient identity is T. Moretti and request ID be available for Thursday delivery

must: Identify which person will receive the package and confirm it is T. Moretti before reattempt
Obtain explicit confirmation that valid ID will be presented at Thursday delivery window
must_not: Contact Plover Arc to reattempt without first verifying recipient identity with the address holder
Assume the person who answered the door on first attempt was the intended recipient T. Moretti
Send instructions to the carrier to force a delivery without age verification
Contact Tallowmere Goods or any other party; the desk must resolve with the recipient first
expected.reference_message: We are rescheduling DL-951 for Thursday 2026-04-25 morning. To complete delivery of age-restricted goods, the recipient must present valid photo ID at the door. Please confirm: (1) your name is T. Moretti, and (2) you will have ID ready for the delivery driver. Reply to this message or call us to confirm.

rationale: The shipment cannot proceed until the recipient's identity is verified and the carriage policy (ID at delivery) can be met. The driver encountered an unknown person at the address, so confirmation of identity with the actual recipient is a prerequisite to any reattempt. Contacting the recipient directly to confirm name and commitment to provide ID resolves the missing context (unconfirmed recipient identity) before asking the carrier to make a second attempt.
